scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: I'm reaching out about the status of my housing loan application that I submitted recently. I was wondering if you could tell me what the is - has it been approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application, LOAN-00206, has been processed, and the action taken was that the loan was originated, meaning it has been approved and funded.

dialogue.user: I'm glad to hear that my loan application was approved. Can you tell me what my interest rate is and what the total costs of the loan are? I'm trying to understand the terms of the loan. Additionally, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan that I should be aware of?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate offered for your loan is 6.999%. Unfortunately, the record does not provide the total loan costs. Regarding high-cost flags, your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA. Additionally, your loan does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: I appreciate the information. A 6.999% interest rate seems a bit higher than I was hoping for, but I'll take a closer look at the details. You mentioned that the record doesn't provide the total loan costs - is there anything else you can tell me about the loan terms or any other relevant details? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The loan term is 360 months, as requested in your application. The debt-to-income ratio for your loan is 44%. This is calculated by dividing your total monthly debt payments by your total monthly income. As for the purchaser type, this field is not applicable for your loan, indicating that the loan was not sold to another institution after origination. I've provided all the details available in the record.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for providing that information. A 44% debt-to-income ratio is a bit higher than I was hoping for, but I understand how it's calculated. I'm glad to hear that the loan wasn't sold to another institution. I think I've got all the questions I had, and I appreciate your help in clarifying the terms of my loan. I'm satisfied with the interaction and the information you provided. 

<Very Satisfied> - I'm very satisfied with the interaction. The agent was competent, courteous, and provided clear and accurate information about my loan application. They addressed all my questions and concerns in a professional and timely manner.
